extra_brief:
Egypt oil/NGL specifics:
- Research in ARABIC as well as English. The decisive sources are usually Arabic: petroleum.gov.eg, egpc.com.eg, youm7.com, elwatannews.com, almalnews.com, egyptoil-gas.com (bilingual), Al-Borsa, Amwal Al Ghad.
- Key operators: EGPC (Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation), PPC / Petroleum Pipelines Company (شركة أنابيب البترول), SUMED / Arab Petroleum Pipelines Co. (Ain Sokhna <-> Sidi Kerir), ASORC (Assiut refinery), MIDOR and ANRPC (Alexandria), Suez Oil Processing Co.
- 'Badr El Din Company' in Egyptian sources means BAPETCO the OPERATOR, not the BED field. Do not conflate them.
- Researcher initials 'NA' are a real code (Nagwa), not a missing value.
- Wikipedia IS citable (policy confirmed 2026-08-27). gem.wiki is NEVER a source, in any field.
- BANNED absolutely: abarrelfull.wikidot.com / abarrelfull.co.uk. Never cite it, never use it as corroboration, never mention it as support. If a value appears only there, treat the value as UNSOURCED and chase the primary source it footnotes instead.
- A 403 / geo-block / TLS failure / timeout is a BLOCK, not a deletion. Only a confirmed 404 or 410 means a page is gone. Never report a blocked page as dead.
- The harvested wiki-citation pool (if you are given one) is a WORKLIST, not a lookup table: do not stop at the first sufficient source. Report how many of the harvested citations you actually opened.
- Beware SOFT 404s: some Egyptian corporate sites return HTTP 200 with a shell page for any slug. If a page 200s but carries no article, say so; prove it by fetching a nonsense sibling slug and diffing the body size.

DUPLICATE / IDENTITY WATCHLIST for this scope (the orchestrator's read of the roster — treat each as a QUESTION to answer with sources, not a conclusion to confirm):
- P0530 vs P5121: both 'Sumed Oil Pipeline', both Ain Sukhna->Alexandria, both 320 km / 42 in / 1,250,000 capacity. Near-identical. Are these two physical parallel lines (SUMED is famously a TWIN 42-inch system) or one row entered twice? Sources must say.
- P7977 vs P7978: both 'El-Hafair-Musturad Oil Pipelines', 135 km/18,20 in vs 115 km/24 in.
- P7318 vs P7319: both 'Musturad-Banha Oil Products Pipeline', 45 km operating vs 52 km construction.
- P7325 vs P7334: both 'El-Tibeen-Asyut Oil Products Pipeline', 75 km construction vs 376 km operating.
- P7316 vs P7342: both 'El Minya-Asyut', 140 km construction vs 115 km operating.
- P7332 vs P7337: both 'Suez-Musturad', both 134 km, 12 in vs 18 in.
- P7331 vs P7315: both 'Agroud-Ain Sokhna Oil Pipeline', 35 km vs 65 km, both construction.
- P0572 'Mleiha-El Hamra' vs P5125 'Southwest Mleiha' — different fields or the same trunk?
- P7363 'Ras Ghareb-Asyut LPG' (305 km) vs P7364 'Ras Bakr-Ras Gharb-Asyut LPG' (160 km) — is one a segment of the other?
A same-name pair with DIFFERENT diameters is usually two real parallel lines, not a duplicate. A same-name pair with the same diameter AND the same length is the suspicious case. Say which you found and why.
